definitions.G: Gazebo world ENU converted to fixed NED
definitions.E1: B camera center minus physical camera sphere center
definitions.E2: B camera vector with exact model pose minus G reference
definitions.E3: online P target minus raw G reference (cross-frame)
definitions.E4: online P target minus rigidly mapped G reference
definitions.reference: sphere center plus +Z NED offset from config
definitions.warning: Per-frame map forces the two UAV poses to agree; E4~E1 alone does not prove a fixed frame map.
